title: Henry as eccentric trombonist; none of the brothers read music
summary: Merritt says Henry originated playing trombone with his foot, was the only reader, and that the others picked up their instruments themselves.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

You say Henry could read a good reader, but the rest of you never did learn to read. No, none of us read outside of Henry. Henry would sit down and play first chair in a big 60-piece band.
